eventDetail.scope: The 10th IEEE International Conference on Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems (ICPS 2027) focuses on cutting-edge research and applications in Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems, Industry 4.0, and AI-assisted Digital Transformation. The conference provides an international platform for academics, researchers, and industry professionals to share innovations, solutions, and experiences in areas such as Industrial IoT, automation, cybersecurity, smart manufacturing, and data-driven technologies.
